supporting_news.title: Treasury rally spills over to Indian bonds, debt supply slows move
supporting_news.summary: Indian government bonds saw slight gains, reflecting the upward trend in US Treasuries. Investors are keeping a close eye on the forthcoming weekly debt auction, pivotal for market movements. With retail inflation and fluctuating oil prices in play, the Reserve Bank of India may entertain further rate hikes. Although benchmark Brent crude holds steady, it remains vulnerable to geopolitical shifts, prompting caution among traders as they await auction results.
